test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 10 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Vigorous
solution:
The solution is **Frail**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate ANTONYM of 'Vigorous' is 'Frail'. 
 
• ​Frail- weak and delicate.
 
• Vigorous - Strong, healthy, and full of energy.
 
 
• *​For example: "A tall, vigorous and muscular man."*
 
 
 
• *​*Therefore **option 3 **is the correct option.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Antonyms - **Antonym is opposite of meaning of given word.
 
• Antonym of** *****Buoyant** *is ***heavy.***
 
• Antonym of ***Sturdy** *is ***puny.***
 
• Antonym of ***Robust** *is ***weak.***
